recommendation_summary: Set up a single external dead-man's-switch monitor that `nightly-sync` pings only when it finishes successfully, so the monitor emails the user if the ping misses the daily deadline, then test it by deliberately skipping a ping.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker are unnecessary for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only after finishing, so a startup crash leaves you unaware.
labels.Checked myself: From what you told me, cron runs it at 03:00 on `edna`; an expired token caused four startup failures, and no independent alert exists.

note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert and says the Synology doesn't need to run anything; its "Checked myself" line cites only facts the user gave.
